title: 2027 Winter Co-Ops - Software Development - Demonware (Dublin)
description: **Job Title:** 2027 Winter Co\-Ops \- Software Development \- Demonware (Dublin) **Requisition ID:** R027957 **Job Description:** This role is based onsite at the Demonware Dublin office, **onsite** . **About Demonware** Demonware is a member of the Activision family of studios, partnering with engineers and creatives across AAA game studios to deliver the online and data services that power some of the world’s biggest franchises — including *Call of Duty* and *Crash Bandicoot* . We’re a technology company that values openness and collaboration. We believe the best ideas win, everyone should feel empowered to contribute, and while we take our work seriously, we don’t take ourselves too seriously. At Demonware, you’ll find big\-company challenges with a small\-company culture. We support millions of concurrent users and work with technologies such as Python, C\+\+, Java, Linux, MySQL, Erlang, and Kubernetes. Our co\-op students make real contributions — many see their code running in production within days of joining. Co\-op Program Requirements * Currently enrolled in a post\-secondary or graduate program * Expected graduation between January 2027 and May 2028 * Available for an 8\-month, in\-person co\-op starting January 2027 * Clear written and verbal communication * Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills * Resume and transcript required * As part of the interview process, candidates will be required to complete an automated coding assessment Specific Role Requirements **Software Engineering** Software Engineering Co\-ops have touched many aspects of Demonware. Needs may shift across each team, but co\-ops in the past have helped build multiplayer features, develop core backend systems, and design tools for largescale distributed services. They gain hands\-on experience working with Kubernetes infrastructure, automation frameworks, and scalable data pipelines. Throughout the co\-op, they collaborate in design discussions, perform root cause analysis, and automate workflows to improve reliability, performance, and developer experience. **Requirements:** * Strong knowledge of Python, C\+\+, and/or Java * Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures * Familiarity with Linux and source control (Git preferred) * Knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP, UDP, HTTP) **Nice\-to\-Have Skills:** * Experience with SQL\-based databases (MySQL preferred) * Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools for automating build, test, and deployment * Familiarity with Kubernetes * Exposure to security and scalability concepts * Experience building RESTful services or web applications * Clear passion for computer science showcased through personal projects, or extracurricular activities preferred **Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)** Site Reliability Engineering Co\-ops maintain and evolve Demonware’s platform while contributing to the design of highly reliable operational architecture. Co\-ops ensure services are scalable, maintainable, and built for players worldwide, working closely with cross disciplinary teams throughout the development lifecycle. They also collaborate with experienced engineers across global offices, gaining exposure to high impact, large scale systems engineering. **Requirements:** * Strong knowledge of Python, C\+\+, and/or Java * Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures * Experience with SQL\-based databases (MySQL preferred) * Knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP, UDP, HTTP) * Familiarity with Linux and source control (Git preferred) * Scripting experience (Bash, and/or Groovy) * Knowledge of foundational technologies such as TCP/IP and Linux/Unix internals Nice\-to\-Have Skills * Familiarity with Kubernetes * Multi\-platform development experience * Exposure to security and scalability concepts * Experience building RESTful services or web applications How to Stand Out **We Encourage You To Highlight:** * Specific contributions on previous work/projects * Any Linux experience (school, personal, or home projects) * Programming\-related hobbies or personal projects * Notable school assignments * Open\-source contributions * Links to code repositories, portfolios, or technical blogs Office Perks * Complimentary breakfast, lunch, and drinks from a fully stocked kitchen * BBQs and Lunch \& Learns * City\-center office location * Vacation allowance * Competitive pay * Free games How to Apply You can apply directly at demonware.net. Applicants will hear back from a recruiter or WorkDay by December 2027\. We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under\-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! At Activision Blizzard, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply. Our World At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences. We’re not just looking back at our decades\-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization. We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up. **Ready to Activate Your Future?** *The videogame industry and therefore our business is fast\-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business and relationships with industry partners.* *We are committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a disabled individual requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to* accommodationrequests@activisionblizzard.com *. General employment questions cannot be accepted or processed here. Thank you for your interest.*

title: Accommodation Assistant

title: Actuarial Expert
description: The Allianz Group is a global financial services provider with services predominantly in the insurance and asset management business. Allianz SE, the parent company, is headquartered in Munich, Germany. Allianz has established a specialist Branch, Allianz SE Dublin Reinsurance Branch. The branch's premises are at Allianz House, Elmpark, Merrion Road, Dublin 4\. **Job Description** We are looking for an Actuarial Expert to join our Corporate Actuarial team at Allianz Re in Dublin. Reporting to the Head of P\&C Reserving, you will be part of a small, collaborative and highly professional team, fully integrated with all aspects of quarterly and annual reporting under IFRS 17 and Solvency II. This is an excellent opportunity for a nearly or newly qualified actuary to deepen their technical expertise in a global reinsurance environment, working with modern tools including ResQ, Unify, SAS and advanced Excel. **Key Responsibilities** * Perform reserving on IFRS 17 and Solvency II bases across assigned global reinsurance segments * Carry out underwriting risk capital calculations as part of the entity's Solvency II internal capital model * Contribute to quarterly roll\-forward exercises and annual deep\-dive reserve reviews * Support experience analysis and assumption setting for Life \& Health and/or Property \& Casualty lines * Assess reserve adequacy, monitor trends and emerging risks * Perform stress testing, sensitivity analysis and scenario modelling from both reserving and risk capital perspectives * Identify opportunities for model improvements and support their implementation * Communicate findings clearly to stakeholders across the business What We're Looking For **Required Qualifications \& Experience** * Close to completing (or recently completed) fellowship of a recognised actuarial body (e.g. IFoA) * University degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative discipline * 3\+ years' experience in IFRS and/or Solvency II reserving, local regulatory reserving, or capital modelling in a reinsurance or insurance environment * Good understanding of IFRS 17 concepts; practical experience (e.g. in IFRS 17 testing or development) is a strong advantage Technical Skills * Programming and database proficiency, SAS and SQL are essential * Strong MS Excel skills including VBA and Power Query * Experience with DFA, risk capital or cashflow modelling would be an advantage Personal Attributes * Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail * Clear and confident communicator, both written and verbal * Comfortable working independently and managing competing priorities * A collaborative team player who thrives in an international working environment * Structured approach to complex actuarial problems **Responsibilities** At Allianz Re, we are committed to embracing innovation and the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence to enhance our work. We particularly value candidates who demonstrate: * Curiosity and a proactive approach to learning new tools and methodologies * Awareness of AI\-powered tools and their application in actuarial and data analysis * An interest in data\-driven decision\-making and continuous improvement What We Offer * Study support for actuarial professional examinations * Exposure to a diverse, global reinsurance portfolio * A supportive, close\-knit team environment with direct access to senior leadership * Opportunities for professional growth within the wider Allianz Group * Modern tools and technology to support your work Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust. We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. Join us **. Let's care for tomorrow.**

title: Associate Interior Designer
description: Rhythm Careers is working with an ambitious, early stage interior and architecture practice based in Dublin's city centre, to appoint an Associate Interior Designer. title: Commercial & Finance Assistant
description: **Commercial \& Finance Assistant** Greyhound Recycling is looking for a versatile, commercially\-minded Commercial \& Finance Assistant to support material trading, subsidy claims, fleet renewal planning, and finance and site operations at our Crag Avenue facility. Greyhound employs over 200 people at its Crag Avenue facility, Dublin 22\. This is a genuinely varied, hands\-on role — no two days look the same, and priorities can shift quickly. In one week you might be chasing a subsidy deadline, pricing a load of material, comparing fleet replacement options, and fielding a call from an overseas buyer. We need someone who wants that variety and exposure to the commercial engine room of the business, not a narrow administrative post — and who is comfortable picking things up, working out what needs doing, and getting on with it. Your work will involve trading commodities and disposal outlets, capital expenditure evaluation, subsidy claims, and fleet planning, as well as day\-to\-day finance and operational tasks. There is real scope for the right person to help the business build direct export relationships alongside our existing broker channels. **The Role** You will provide broad\-based support across four connected areas of the business — moving between them as the week demands, rather than sticking to one lane: * **Materials trading** — tracking commodity and disposal volumes, pricing, and outlet performance; helping prepare and follow up on trading paperwork * **Outlets, customers and export development** — supporting the search for new outlets and buyers, maintaining relationships with existing customers and hauliers, and helping develop direct export routes to end\-users rather than relying solely on brokers * **Finance and subsidy administration** — assisting with subsidy claims and supporting documentation, budget tracking, and general finance tasks * **Fleet and capex support —** helping build and maintain fleet renewal schedules, and preparing data and comparisons to support capex proposals **Key Responsibilities** * Maintain and update spreadsheets and trackers for material volumes, pricing, and outlet/customer performance * Prepare, check, and file trading documentation (weighbridge dockets, consignment notes, invoices, contracts) * Support subsidy claim preparation — gathering evidence, checking figures, and meeting submission deadlines * Assist with fleet renewal planning: maintaining asset registers, tracking vehicle age/condition/costs, and building comparison data for capex decisions * Liaise directly with customers, outlets, and suppliers by phone and email — building and maintaining good working relationships * Research and help open up direct export outlets for recovered materials, reducing reliance on brokers and building relationships directly with end\-buyers * Produce clear, accurate reports and summaries from Excel for internal decision\-making * Pick up a wide range of ad\-hoc duties as they arise — priorities will shift at short notice; examples include tracking projects and initiatives through to completion, or evaluating software and tools relevant to the business * Provide general finance and administrative support as workload requires **What We're Looking For** * Ideally 2–5 years' relevant experience in a finance, trading, commercial, or customer\-facing operations role * Experience in exporting, international trade, or direct dealings with overseas buyers is strongly preferred — this role has real scope to help develop direct export routes rather than working solely through brokers * Strong Excel skills essential (formulas, pivot tables, data tracking etc); comfort learning fleet/finance systems * Excellent written and verbal communication — confident dealing with customers, outlets, and overseas contacts * Experience in customer relations or waste/recycling commodities is beneficial but not essential * Organised, accurate, and comfortable managing several workstreams at once — you'll enjoy the variety rather than needing a fixed daily routine * A real self\-starter — happy to work things out, make a start without waiting for detailed instructions, and take initiative * No formal qualification is required — we're looking for the right blend of skills, commercial instinct, and attitude. **Systems \& Tools** You'll work primarily in Excel, alongside our fleet management and finance/accounting systems. Full training on internal systems will be provided — no prior experience with our specific software is required. **Why Join Greyhound Recycling** * Broad, varied role with real exposure to trading, finance, and fleet decision\-making * Work directly alongside senior team members across multiple parts of the business — strong mentoring and development potential * Values\-driven organisation with a strong track record of internal training and promotion * Company events and free on\-site parking

title: Communications Graduate
description: **The Role:** BnM is seeking a Communications Graduate to join our team in Newbridge on a Fixed Term Contract. The Comms Graduate will be required to provide operational, organisational and administrative support to the Comms \& Engagement team, ensuring that day‑to‑day activities and wider departmental functions run smoothly. The role supports documentation management, financial and procurement processes, internal communication, and meeting coordination, while maintaining strong governance, confidentiality, and compliance standards. The Comms Graduate is a central point of support and coordination, helping the team remain organised, efficient, and focused on delivering core priorities. Additionally, the Comms Graduate will be given the opportunity to own specific projects within each of the functions within Comms \& Engagement, most notably in the space of Community Benefit Funds, Sponsorship, Events and PR. The main duties and responsibilities of the role will include the following: * Project \& Team Support: Support CSR team with management of Community Benefit Funds, donation requests and sponsorship activity and create relevant SOPs. Conduct research into relevant \& credible industry awards and manage applications and advertising for awards as required. Track and manage press release document control, filing and distribution. Provide administrative assistance to team projects, working groups, and priority initiatives. Support onboarding of new/returning team members, including equipment coordination and induction scheduling. Assist in tracking project timelines, documentation, and reporting requirements. * Document, Data \& Systems Management: Store, organise, and manage documentation on SharePoint, ensuring correct versioning and accessibility. Act as the central point for version control of approved branded materials (Word, PowerPoint, templates). Ensure documents comply with organisational brand, quality, and governance standards. Support maintenance of team data records, registers, and audit trails. * Meetings, Coordination \& Engagement Support: Schedule and coordinate meetings, workshops, and team sessions. Prepare and distribute agendas, papers, and supporting materials. Take minutes and circulate action notes where required, ensuring follow‑up on agreed actions. Support engagement activities such as public consultations, including materials preparation, and manage bookings, logistics, technical needs for meetings (rooms, equipment, virtual platforms) and team coordination. * Finance, Procurement \& Compliance: Create and process purchase orders on Oracle and assist with PO tracking, supplier onboarding and invoice processing. Administer team timesheets for P30 or equivalent reporting. Maintain accurate financial records and follow procurement procedures and audit policies. * Communication \& Stakeholder Liaison: Collaborate with Internal Comms Exec to deliver internal events for employees. Support internal communications within the team, including preparing updates, notices, and team information. Liaise with internal departments to support smooth information flow and coordination. * Community Relations \& Engagement: Manage incoming and outgoing post, ensuring timely distribution. Scan documents, including feedback forms and consultation materials, and share them with relevant colleagues. Manage and maintain confidential information in line with data‑protection and organisational policies. Maintain accurate digital and physical filing systems. Update and maintain internal trackers, logs, and registers. Attend consultation events as required. * All employees are expected to co\-operate fully with all provisions taken by the company for ensuring Health and Safety, and Welfare of co\-employees and members of the public using the premises. * Proactively participate in the Performance Management process to ensure delivery of own, and the wider team's objectives. **What we're looking for:** The ideal candidate will possess the following qualification, skills, knowledge, and attributes: * Degree qualification, ideally in a business\-related discipline. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a strong command of English. Strong organisational, administrative and multitasking skills. High level of attention to detail and accuracy. * Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion. Action\-oriented, results\-driven approach with a proactive mindset. Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work independently and collaboratively. Positive, flexible and can\-do attitude. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Experience using SharePoint or similar document management systems. Experience with Oracle or similar finance and procurement systems. Previous experience in a fast\-paced commercial or corporate environment. * Experience supporting events, consultations and stakeholder engagement activities. Flexibility to work evenings and weekends as required to attend community meetings or events. Additional qualifications in stakeholder engagement, negotiation, mediation, GIS, or project management would be desirable.

title: Copywriter
description: **Job title: Copywriter (as part of a creative team or solo)** **Location: Dublin, Ireland** **Who We Are** Droga5, part of Accenture Song, is a creative agency with offices in Dublin, New York, London, Tokyo and São Paulo. From integrated communications and experience innovation to business design, we exist to create a radically unique answer every time for our clients – and in doing so, build and sustain the most influential brands of the 21st century through creativity. Droga5 was founded in 2006 and has been recognized as Agency of the Year more than 25 times and was named both *Ad Age* and *Adweek’s* Agency of the Decade (2010–2019\). Visit Droga5\.ie or @droga5 on all social platforms to get to know us better. **Creative @ Droga5** Creatives join Droga5 to do the best work of their careers \- work that moves people and creates a positive impact on society, from a deep laugh to a shift in cultural norms. We’re always ambitious, infiltrating culture and changing minds. Our work is set apart by its point of view, and we know we’re only as good as the last piece of work that went out the door. We’re a generous department who help each other, learn from each other, and respect each other. We know we’re at our best when everyone here is supportive of one another. About the work and our people, we care more. **Job Summary** We're looking for an enthusiastic Copywriter to join our creative team. You'll work alongside senior writers, art directors, and designers to craft compelling copy across digital ads, social media, brand campaigns, and more. You'll bring fresh ideas to brainstorming sessions, help shape brand voices, and contribute to work that's as strategically smart as it is creatively exciting. The ideal candidate is a natural storyteller who sweats the details and loves the craft. You're comfortable in a fast\-paced environment, can juggle multiple projects, and see feedback as part of the process. A portfolio that shows your range and creative thinking matters more to us than a perfect CV — so if you're curious, driven, and passionate about great writing, we'd love to hear from you. **Job Responsibilities** - Support senior creatives in developing ideas across a range of briefs, taking on increasing ownership as confidence and experience grows - Write across different forms of media, including scripts, digital, content, and social - Contribute to client presentations and begin building client relationships under the guidance of senior team members - Explore and familiarise yourself with GenAI tools and how they can be incorporated into the creative process - Develop an understanding of strategy and ensure all ideas are on brief - Manage your own workload across multiple projects and deliverables, with support from senior colleagues - Assist in production and post\-production processes, building knowledge across all facets - Collaborate across disciplines to help deliver projects to a high creative standard and on time - Develop your presentation skills, building confidence in sharing ideas both internally and with clients - Give and receive constructive feedback openly and respectfully - Show a positive and resilient attitude, embracing the challenges and opportunities that come with agency life - Be an enthusiastic and reliable collaborator across the wider team, including D5 Dublin, Song Ireland, and global partners **Basic Qualifications** - Portfolio or samples of work demonstrating smart, brand\-building ideas and executions **Preferred Qualifications** - Multi\-faceted in developing different types of creative media - Some production experience in any of the different types of productions - Strong and developing storytelling skills - Ability to work independently - Collaborative and team oriented with proficiency working with members of all different departments, with minimal supervision - Strong oral, written communication and presentation skills for effective communication to clients, internal team and management

title: Customer Assistant -  Baggot Street Upper (Permanent 20 - 25 hours)
description: **About the role** We pride ourselves on offering customers the biggest range of products around. And that's not just food, but everything from clothes and kettles to financial services. But did you know we offer the biggest job opportunities too? With stores across the UK and Ireland, and a variety of roles, we are always looking for people who are as passionate about helping customers as we are. Our Every Little Helps approach doesn't just apply to our customers. It's at the very heart of everything we do at work \- and it's what makes us different. We believe in treating each other with respect, and everyone having the opportunity to get on. That's what makes Tesco such a great place to work. Should you be successful in your application, your offer will be subject to and conditional upon you providing your bank account details before your agreed start date. **You will be responsible for** * Always put the customer first and consider them in everything you do. * Get to know your customers and serve them with pride. * Help to ensure products and services are available for customers at all times. * Handle all products with care to maintain quality and ensure they reach the customer in the best condition. * Keep the shop floor and back areas clean and tidy at all times. * Using the training you receive, follow department routines and processes. * Follow all company policies and adhere to Health and Safety routines. * Whilst you will have a core role, you may be asked to support your colleagues by helping in other departments. **You will need** * Able to give great, natural customer service by proactively smiling, greeting, acknowledging and helping customers. * Works hard for customers, your team and your department. * You are able to prioritise to ensure anything you do is right for our customers. * Adaptable and resilient to meet the ever changing demands of our business. * You must be able to follow instructions either verbal or written. * You are reliable and a good timekeeper. * You must be smart and tidy at all times. **Whats in it for you?** We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren't limited to: * Competitive Salary * Bonus Scheme\* * Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost. * 24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life. * Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F\&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2nd Clubcard available.\* * Life Assurance * Pension Plan\* * Save As You Earn Scheme\* * Paid Family Leave * Bike to Work * Long Service Awards * Commuter Scheme * \*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply **About Us** Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer's favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move. Our core purpose is "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day". Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers. It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children's Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7\.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity. Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190\+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers \- of which almost three\-quarters are small and medium enterprises \- which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1\.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food. We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards. We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best. We know life looks a little different for each of us. That's why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life\-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support. Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. We're committed to providing a fully inclusive recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require. For further information on the accessibility support we can offer, please click http://roi.tesco\-careers.com/accessibility/ How can I let Tesco know I need additional support? Please let us know you need additional support by emailing tescoireland.recruitment@tesco.ie This will allow us to understand more about you and how we can best support you through the recruitment process.

description: **Founder’s Associate – Business Operations** **I’m looking for an exceptional person who wants to build a career rather than simply find a job.** You will work directly with me as I build and grow the ActionCOACH Associate Business Coach Model in Ireland. This is a **startup business and a chance** to learn how a business operates across a wide range of areas, including operations, marketing, business development, client relationships, franchise partner support, bookkeeping and recruitment. **The Opportunity** This is a broad, hands\-on opportunity for someone who wants to understand how a business actually works. You will have the opportunity to learn by doing — taking responsibility for real work, solving problems, dealing with clients and prospects, coordinating with suppliers and Franchise Partners, and helping me to build the business. The role will give you exposure to the commercial, operational and practical realities of running a business, while developing the skills and experience needed to take on greater responsibility over time. **What You’ll Do** **Business \& Executive Support** You will work directly with me across a wide range of business activities and priorities. This will include helping to organise, coordinate and follow through on projects, preparing information, conducting research, dealing with correspondence and making sure important actions are followed through to completion. A key part of the role is being able to take something that needs to be done, work out what is required and own it until it is completed. **Business Operations** You will gain practical experience across the day\-to\-day operation of the business. This may include: * Managing and improving administrative and operational processes * Maintaining systems and records * Coordinating suppliers and external service providers * Researching issues and identifying solutions * Supporting business projects * Improving how things are organised and delivered * Taking responsibility for getting things done **Marketing** You will support the implementation and coordination of our marketing activity. We work with an external marketing specialist, so you do not need to be a marketing specialist yourself. Your role will be to help coordinate activity, communicate with external providers, make sure agreed campaigns and activities are implemented, follow up on actions and ensure the marketing initiatives are launched and completed properly. You will also gain exposure to areas such as content, campaigns, lead generation and digital marketing. **Business Development** Business development will be an important part of the role. You will learn how to identify potential clients and opportunities, initiate conversations, follow up leads, qualify prospects and help move opportunities forward. This may include: * Prospect research * Lead generation * Cold calling * Following up enquiries and leads * Speaking with prospective clients * Qualifying opportunities * Maintaining follow\-up activity * Arranging conversations and meetings * Supporting the development of new business You will develop an understanding of how marketing and business development work together to create commercial opportunities. **Client Relationships** You will have exposure to our clients and will help coordinate client\-related activity. This will include communication, follow\-up, scheduling, information gathering and ensuring that actions are completed. The objective is to develop a strong understanding of what clients need and how a professional business maintains effective client relationships. Franchise Partner Support You will also provide support and coordination for our ActionCOACH Franchise Partners. This will give you exposure to another important part of the business — working with independent business owners who are themselves running their own coaching businesses. You will help with communication, coordination, follow\-up, information and the practical support required to help Franchise Partners operate effectively. **Finance \& Bookkeeping** You will gain practical experience in the financial administration of the business. This will include routine bookkeeping and financial processes using Xero, including: * Raising and sending monthly client invoices * Bank reconciliation * Recording and reconciling payments * Debtors and creditors * Calculating Franchise Partner marketing and royalty fees * Raising and sending Franchise Partner invoices * Supporting VAT and financial system reporting You do not need to be an accountant or have an accounting qualification. What matters is that you are comfortable working with numbers, systems and detail and are willing to learn. **Recruitment** You will support recruitment activity as we grow the business. This will include helping with recruitment campaigns, candidate communication, interview coordination, follow\-up and the administration of the recruitment process. You will be exposed to the recruitment of future Business Coaches, Executive Coaches and other members of the team. **Projects \& Business Improvement** You will be expected to become someone who sees what needs to be done rather than waiting to be told every step. You may be given a problem, a project or an objective and asked to work out how to achieve it. That could involve research, identifying options, developing a solution, coordinating other people and taking the project through to completion. **This Role Requires a Generalist Mindset** This is not a role where you will spend your time doing one repetitive task. The purpose of the role is to give you exposure to the different components of a business and help you understand how they connect. You might be working on a marketing campaign in the morning, following up a prospective client later that day, reconciling payments in Xero, coordinating with a Franchise Partner and then helping solve an operational problem. You will need to be comfortable with that variety. **Essential Skills \& Experience** You do not need to have worked in all of these areas before. However, you will need to demonstrate: * **Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly, confidently and professionally in a business environment** * **You should have a genuine interest in personal development, goal setting and helping people achieve their goals.** * Good business and commercial understanding * The ability to think logically and in a structured way * Strong attention to detail * Good organisational skills * Confidence communicating with people * The ability to use initiative * The ability to learn quickly * Comfort working with numbers and financial information * Good computer and systems skills * The ability to manage multiple priorities * A willingness to make phone calls and speak directly with prospects and clients * The ability to follow up and see things through to completion Previous experience in business, sales, marketing, operations, finance, recruitment or administration would be useful, but it is not essential. What matters more is your ability, attitude, commercial awareness and willingness to learn. The Person I Am Looking For I am looking for someone who is: * Ambitious * Curious * Commercially aware * Energetic * Proactive * Organised * Resilient * Comfortable taking responsibility * A good communicator * A completer\-finisher * Willing to learn * Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment You should be someone who has life and career goals, who is known to go the extra mile and wants to understand **why** things are done, not simply be told **what** to do. You should also be comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions respectfully and working out better ways of doing things. **What Success Looks Like** Success in this role is not simply completing a list of tasks. It means becoming someone I can give responsibility to and know that it will get done. You will increasingly be able to: * Understand what needs to be done * Work out how to do it * Take ownership * Communicate clearly * Follow up without being reminded * Solve problems * Deal confidently with clients, prospects, Franchise Partners and suppliers * Understand the commercial implications of decisions * Identify opportunities to improve the business * Take a project from an idea through to completion Over time, I want you to understand the business well enough to see things that need attention before I have to point them out. **Where This Can Lead** **This role is designed for someone who wants to build a career in ActionCOACH and is not suitable for someone who needs a job while waiting for the right opportunity in their field of professional choice.** **For the right person, the longer\-term opportunity can include developing into a Business Coach / Executive Coach, with the potential for a future partnership opportunity.** **Location** **This is an on\-site role based in Portmarnock, Dublin.** **This is not a remote position.** **How to Apply** If this opportunity interests you, please **send your CV and a WhatsApp message to Paul Fagan on 087 987 8666** and answer the following four questions: **1\. What attracted you to this opportunity?** **2\. Why are you applying for a Founder’s Associate – Business Operations role at this stage of your career, and where do you see yourself in five years’ time?** **3\. What is the biggest achievement in your life so far, and how did you achieve it?** **4\. What is the biggest challenge you have overcome in your life so far, and how did you overcome it?** **NOTE:** **I am very interested in hearing from you, not from ChatGPT.** **Please answer the questions in your own words. Don’t worry about making your answers sound polished or professional. Personality and authenticity matter more than perfect wording.** **AI tools can be very useful, but please don’t use them to write your answers for you.** **Applicants who don’t follow this instruction will not be considered.** **Thank you.**

title: Procurement Administrator

Ornua has revenues of €3\.4 billion and is supported by a global team of approximately 2,800 employees. The Group operates as a commercial organisation across 10 business units, including 12 production facilities located in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Africa. The commercial organisation is responsible for the marketing and sales of Ornua’s consumer brands including Ireland’s most successful food export: Kerrygold. Consumer markets are served by production facilities in Ireland, Germany and the UK and by in\-market Sales \& Marketing Teams in Asia, Germany, Ireland, MEA, Poland, Spain, rest of Europe and North and Latin America. It also manages the procurement of Irish and non\-Irish dairy products, the sale of dairy ingredients to food manufacturing and foodservice customers globally, and the implementation of de\-risking and trading strategies to manage market volatility. These activities are supported by production facilities and in\-market teams in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Africa. WHY THIS ROLE IS VALUABLE: The Procurement Operations Administrator provides administrative and operational support to the Global Procurement team, ensuring the effective management of procurement systems, supplier information, purchasing data and reporting processes. The role plays a key part in maintaining data accuracy, supporting procurement governance and assisting category teams with day\-to\-day transactional activities across multiple spend categories. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and detail\-oriented individual looking to develop a career in procurement, supply chain or business operations. KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY: Procurement Systems \& Data Administration * Maintain procurement and sourcing systems, ensuring data accuracy and integrity. * Support supplier master data creation, updates and ongoing maintenance. * Administer user access permissions and system roles. * Assist with the preparation and maintenance of procurement reports and dashboards. * Support continuous improvement of procurement processes and data quality. Purchasing \& Contract Administration * Create and maintain Purchase Agreements (PAs) and Purchase Orders (POs) in line with approved procurement processes. * Support procurement governance by ensuring appropriate documentation and approvals are in place. * Maintain contract records, supplier documentation and associated databases. * Monitor contract renewal dates and key procurement milestones. * Assist with tender administration, including document management and data room support. Supplier Administration * Maintain supplier onboarding records and certification documentation. * Support the management of approved supplier lists and frameworks. * Maintain supplier rate cards and pricing information within procurement systems. * Ensure supplier information is accurate, up to date and compliant with company requirements. Reporting \& Compliance Support * Produce routine spend, usage and compliance reports. * Assist with supplier and purchase order compliance monitoring. * Support audit requirements through accurate record keeping and transaction tracking. * Help identify inconsistencies in procurement data and escalate issues where appropriate. * Support procurement projects by tracking spend commitments and approved budgets. Cross\-Functional Support * Provide administrative support to procurement category managers and stakeholders. * Respond to procurement\-related queries from internal teams. * Support the implementation of procurement initiatives and process improvements. * Contribute to maintaining high standards of governance and operational excellence across the procurement function. KEY REQUIREMENTS: * 1\-2 years' experience in an administrative, procurement, finance or business support role (or relevant internship/placement experience). * Strong attention to detail and accuracy. * Good organisational and time\-management skills. * Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. * Familiarity with AI\-enabled productivity tools (e.g. Micrsoft Copilot or similiar) and the ability to use them responsibly to improve efficiency and producitvity is desirable. * Ability to work with large volumes of data and maintain accurate records. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. * Exposure to procurement/business operations (including ERP/procurement systems), reporting and data analysis desirable. * Relevant business, procurement or supply chain qualification desirable. Closing date: Thursday October 1st 2026

We also support power \& utility clients in delivering BAU initiatives related to grid planning, operations, and markets. Our offerings span: market and technology design, engineering, technology implementation, data \& analytics, strategy, policy, and customer engagement activities in spaces such as: generation, transmission \& distribution, operations, markets, retail, and regulatory reporting. Specifically, we are looking for subject matter resources ready to transition their expertise to consult for key energy transition clients. If you are a candidate with expertise and experience in a subset of those listed within this posting, please consider applying for this position. Focus areas we are looking to hire for include: Strategy \& business development; Program management; Business architecture, planning, and implementation; Investment planning and economic valuation; and Energy market design. **Ideal applicants will have:** * Strong analytical mindset with ability to synthesize complex information into actionable insights * Strong project management and stakeholder engagement abilities, with experience managing multiple priorities in dynamic environments * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence decision\-making at the executive level * Passion for the energy sector, with a strong interest in utility transformation and emerging technologies * Commitment to continuous learning and professional development in the rapidly evolving energy landscape. **Skills And Attributes For Success** **To qualify for the role, you must have expertise and experience in the following areas:** * Market \& Trading Expertise * Demonstrable experience or strong understanding of ISEM trading activities, including DAM, IDM, BM, and Capacity Market participation. * Understanding of bidding strategies, trading optimisation, and commercial risk management in electricity markets. * Market Design \& Reform Knowledge * Experience or exposure to market design, rule changes, and consultation processes within ISEM or European markets. * Familiarity with upcoming market reforms, including evolving electricity market structures, flexibility markets, and price signal changes. * Regulatory Understanding * Broad knowledge of energy market regulations, including SEMO rules, REMIT, and EU energy policy frameworks (e.g., Clean Energy Package). * Experience supporting or interpreting regulatory submissions, consultations, or compliance requirements. * System Services \& Flexibility * Understanding of current and future system service frameworks, including ancillary services, grid stability, and flexibility markets. * Awareness of how renewables, storage, and demand\-side response interact with system services and market signals. * Analytical \& Consulting Skills * Strong analytical capability, with experience in market modelling, forecasting, or data analysis. * Ability to translate complex market and regulatory concepts into clear, actionable insights for clients. * Experience delivering client\-facing advisory or consulting work is highly desirable but if other criteria met not essential **What Working At EY Offers** We offer a competitive remuneration package. Plus, we offer: * Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues around * Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career * The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you All our employees are given a benefits package which they can tailor to suit their individual preferences. While our client\-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance. **Career Progression** * When you join EY, you will be supported to ensure that you are enhancing your skills from day one. * Continuous learning, where you can develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. * As you grow and develop here, you’ll discover opportunities to help customise your career journey, so that it’s as unique as you are \- success is defined by you, we will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. * Transformative leadership, we will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. * Diverse and inclusive culture, you will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. * We have embraced Hybrid working at EY adding greater flexibility and autonomy to the roles of our employees. **Inclusion \& Diversity** We hold a collective commitment to foster an environment where all differences are valued and respected, practices are equitable and everyone experiences a sense of belonging: Inclusion, diversity, and equity are part of who we are at EY. title: Warehouse Operator
description: **Job Details** **Job Title:** Warehouse Operator **Location:** Naas, Kildare **Work Arrangement:** Onsite **About The Role** The Warehouse Operator is responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day warehouse activities of BNL Sciences, ensuring the safe, accurate and efficient receipt, storage, movement, control and dispatch of materials. The role plays a key part in maintaining inventory accuracy, product integrity and customer service standards while ensuring compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Good Distribution Practice (GDP) where applicable, company procedures and Health \& Safety requirements. The Warehouse Operator works closely with Warehouse, Production, Quality and Customer Service teams to ensure materials are handled, stored and distributed accurately and efficiently in support of business operations and customer requirements. **Key Responsibilities** **Goods Receipt \& Material Handling** * Receive incoming materials and verify deliveries against purchase orders and shipping documentation. * Unload, inspect and transfer materials safely to designated storage locations. * Check goods for damage, shortages or discrepancies and report issues appropriately. * Ensure received materials are correctly identified, labelled and stored. * Maintain accurate records relating to material receipts and inventory movements. * Support quarantine, release and material segregation requirements where applicable. **Inventory Management \& Stock Control** * Accurately pick, move and store materials in accordance with warehouse procedures. * Support inventory accuracy through adherence to stock control processes. * Participate in cycle counts and stock take activities. * Assist with stock reconciliation and investigation of inventory discrepancies. * Maintain full traceability of materials and products. * Ensure stock is rotated appropriately and stored in accordance with company procedures. **Order Fulfilment \& Dispatch** * Pick and prepare orders accurately and efficiently. * Package materials for internal transfer, customer shipment or distribution. * Prepare goods for dispatch in accordance with customer and company requirements. * Complete shipping documentation and records accurately. * Load vehicles safely and in accordance with company procedures. * Support timely and accurate order fulfilment to meet customer expectations. **Warehouse Operations** * Operate warehouse equipment safely and in accordance with training and authorisation. * Maintain warehouse cleanliness and housekeeping standards at all times. * Support efficient warehouse workflows and storage practices. * Assist with repalletising goods and reorganising storage locations where required. * Conduct routine warehouse inspections and report maintenance requirements. * Support warehouse operational activities as directed by management. **Quality \& Compliance** * Comply with GMP, GDP (where applicable), company procedures and quality requirements. * Complete warehouse documentation accurately and in a timely manner. * Maintain inventory traceability and product integrity. * Report deviations, discrepancies and quality concerns promptly. * Support audit readiness and warehouse compliance activities. * Participate in investigations and corrective actions where required. **Skills** * Basic computer literacy and ability to complete warehouse documentation accurately. * Good organisational skills and attention to detail. * Ability to work effectively within a team environment. * Strong communication skills. * Ability to manage physical aspects of warehouse operations safely. * Flexible approach to work and changing business requirements. **Job Requirements** * Previous warehouse, logistics or materials handling experience desirable. * Experience within pharmaceutical, healthcare, manufacturing, life sciences or regulated environments preferred. * Understanding of warehouse operations and inventory control principles. * Experience using warehouse systems, ERP systems or inventory management tools desirable. * Forklift licence or material handling equipment experience desirable. **About Caldic** At Caldic, we’re a global leader in distribution solutions, serving diverse markets across the world. Joining us means becoming part of an entrepreneurial, collaborative, and innovation\-driven team. **We Offer** * Global opportunities with rapid career growth and development * An inclusive, diverse, and dynamic work environment * The chance to shape the future of specialty ingredient solutions across industries like food, pharma, personal care, and more We operate in 43 countries around the world. Our innovative solutions are tailored to meet the needs of industries such as food, pharma, personal care, and industrial markets, ensuring sustainable success for all stakeholders. To learn more, visit: www.caldic.com **Ready to Join Us?** If you're ready to take your career to the next level and join a global leader, apply now at Caldic! **Equal Opportunity Employer** Caldic celebrates diversity and is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, gender, or any other characteristic. Location: Swords, D, IE, K67 A4C5 City: Swords Country/Region: IE

title: Winthrop Technologies: Engineering Graduate Programme 2027
description: **Launch Your Career with Winthrop Technologies** Winthrop Technologies is a dedicated data centre delivery partner providing turnkey solutions to clients across Europe. Headquartered in Dublin, we design and deliver some of the most advanced and innovative data centre projects in the industry. We are seeking ambitious and motivated **graduates** from **Engineering, Construction**, and related disciplines to join Winthrop's Engineering Graduate Programme. This structured programme is designed to provide you with the practical experience, support, and development opportunities needed to build a successful career in the engineering and construction industry while contributing to some of the most exciting projects in Europe. **Graduate Opportunities** We are recruiting interns across the following disciplines: * BIM Engineering * Civil, Structural \& Architectural Engineering * Electrical Engineering * Mechanical Engineering * Environmental, Health \& Safety * Quantity Surveying * Construction Management **Requirements** To be considered, you should: * Hold, or be due to complete by Summer 2027, a Level 7, Level 8, or Level 9 qualification in a relevant Engineering or Construction\-related discipline. * Have graduated, or be scheduled to graduate, between June 2026 and June 2027\. * Demonstrate a genuine interest in engineering, construction, and data centre development. * Be a curious and proactive problem\-solver with a passion for learning and innovation. * Possess strong communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills. * Demonstrate professionalism, reliability, adaptability, and a strong work ethic. **Benefits** As a graduate at Winthrop Technologies, you will gain far more than just your first professional role. You will become part of a dynamic, international team delivering some of Europe's most advanced data centre projects. Our Graduate Programme offers: * **Structured Graduate Development Programme** – Follow a tailored learning journey designed to accelerate your professional and technical development. * **Hands\-on Project Experience** – Contribute to live, large\-scale data centre projects from day one. * **Professional Mentorship** – Receive ongoing support and guidance from experienced engineers, project managers, and technical specialists. * **Technical \& Professional Training** – Access a range of workshops, certifications, and development opportunities to enhance your skills. * **Career Progression Opportunities** – Benefit from clear career pathways and opportunities for advancement within the business. * **Networking Opportunities** – Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across Europe and build valuable professional connections. * **Competitive Package** – Enjoy a competitive salary, performance\-related bonus opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package. ***Winthrop Technologies is an equal opportunities employer***
